description: This is a PHP source file defining the 'Reviewer' entity class within the OrangeHRM project. It models a reviewer in the performance review system, including properties such as status, completed date, comments, and relationships to other entities like ReviewerGroup, PerformanceReview, and Employee. The class uses Doctrine ORM for database mapping and includes methods to get and set its properties.

classes.name: Reviewer
classes.description: Entity class representing a reviewer in the HRM system, with properties for status, comments, completion date, and relations to other entities such as group, review, and employee. Implements getter and setter methods for these properties and integrates Doctrine ORM mappings.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the reviewer.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for the reviewer.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the current status code of the reviewer.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the status code for the reviewer.

methods.name: getCompletedDate
methods.description: Returns the date when the review was completed.

methods.name: setCompletedDate
methods.description: Sets the date when the review was completed.

methods.name: getComment
methods.description: Gets any comment associated with the review.

methods.name: setComment
methods.description: Sets a comment for the review.

methods.name: getGroup
methods.description: Returns the reviewer group associated with this reviewer.

methods.name: setGroup
methods.description: Assigns a reviewer group to this reviewer.

methods.name: getReview
methods.description: Returns the performance review linked to this reviewer.

methods.name: setReview
methods.description: Links a performance review to this reviewer.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Gets the employee associated with this reviewer.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Associates an employee with this reviewer.
